payload.name: Trapped Chest
payload.description: A heavy iron chest sits in the corner. It looks valuable... and suspicious.

success.description: You find and disarm a poison dart trap! The chest contains treasure.

failure.description: You don't notice the trap. A dart shoots out as you open the chest!

choices.description: A dart shoots out and hits you! But at least the treasure is yours.
Sometimes the best treasure is the one you don't open.

authority: Custom Crown campaign event, not an SRD trap/NPC/spell replacement
occurrence_policy: Table may roll again; same in-flight occurrence must not reroll/reapply on reopen. Campaign-specific uniqueness beyond generated room claims is unresolved, not silently global once-per-event-ID.
